verses.gurmukhi: ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਨ ਪੁਜਸਿ ਮਧੁ ਕਰਕ ਸਬਦ ਸਰਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਨ ਬਿਖਮ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: madhur bachan samasar na pujas madh karak sabadh sar bikh na bikham hai ||

en.bdb: Sweetness of honey cannot match the sweetness of sweetly spoken words. No poison is as discomforting as bitter words.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸੀਤਲਤਾ ਮਿਸਟਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਕਰਕ ਸਬਦ ਸ ਤਪਤ ਕਟੁ ਕਮ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: madhur bachan seetalataa misaTaan paan karak sabadh s tapat kaT kam hai ||

en.bdb: Sweet words cools the mind as cold drinks cool the body and provide comfort (during summer), but highly bitter thing is nothing compared to very sharp and harsh words.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਕੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਉ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਕਰਕ ਸਬਦ ਅਸੰਤੋਖ ਦੋਖ ਸ੍ਰਮ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: madhur bachan kai tirapat aau sa(n)tokh saa(n)t karak sabadh asa(n)tokh dhokh sram hai ||

en.bdb: Sweet words render one with peace, satiation and contentment whereas harsh words create restlessness, vice and fatigue.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਲਗਿ ਅਗਮ ਸੁਗਮ ਹੋਇ ਕਰਕ ਸਬਦ ਲਗਿ ਸੁਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ॥੨੫੬॥
verses.translit_en: madhur bachan lag agam sugam hoi karak sabadh lag sugam agam hai ||256||

en.bdb: Sweet words make a difficult task easy to perform whereas harsh and bitter words make an easy task difficult to accomplish. (256)
